description_en: Deletes anti-ransomware policies that are created for databases
description_zh: 删除数据库防勒索策略
name: DeleteUniBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware policy.

You can call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to query the IDs of anti-ransomware policies. You must specify at least one of the PolicyId parameter and the PolicyIds parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数，与PolicyIds参数不能同时为空
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of anti-ransomware policies.

You can call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to query the IDs of anti-ransomware policies. You must specify at least one of the PolicyId parameter and the PolicyIds parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID集合。
调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数，与PolicyId参数不能同时为空
parameters.name: policy_ids
